## About

[falling-pickaxe.vip](https://falling-pickaxe.vip) is an informational site about **Falling Pickaxe** by Pixmove Games (released June 2026). We are not the game developer and do not accept bets.

**Falling Pickaxe** is an instant game: drop a pickaxe down a vertical shaft, smash blocks, collect copper/gold/diamond/emerald payouts, TNT clears paths, upgrade arrows and workbenches strengthen the tool mid-fall. Listed specs: RTP 95%, low volatility, maximum win ×160.

## FAQ quick answers

**What is Falling Pickaxe?** Pixmove instant with a falling pickaxe through a block shaft; ores and special tiles pay; durability limits each drop.

**RTP?** 95% per Pixmove studio sheet — confirm live tier at your casino.

**Max win?** ×160 the stake.

**Demo?** Available on the Pixmove website; real-money play via licensed operators listed on this site.

**Falling Pickaxe vs Mine Slot?** Falling Pickaxe = single vertical drop (Pixmove, low vol). Mine Slot = InOut dig-hybrid with reels and a field.
